== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rebel Trooper (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Rebel Trooper]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/rebel_trooper_japanese_white_border/50618 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/1fa1653e85be4810bb6e857f3ecf06b6/IMG_20220607_0126.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(4, 3, 328, 474)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>30d80b3f8e8071132902283c20f37001c1647e450fcff189fe97c93542a986de</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
